# Lab 20.3: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS for Cost Analysis

## What We Are Going to Do
Calculate on-demand cost per user, per day and per label from the JOBS views.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Cost per user (on-demand).** Check the current on-demand price per TiB for your region on the BigQuery pricing page and put it in the variable.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">DECLARE price_per_tib FLOAT64 DEFAULT 6.25;

SELECT
  user_email,
  COUNT(*) AS queries,
  ROUND(SUM(total_bytes_billed) / POW(1024, 4), 4) AS tib_billed,
  ROUND(SUM(total_bytes_billed) / POW(1024, 4) * price_per_tib, 2) AS est_cost_usd
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_PROJECT
WHERE creation_time &gt; TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  AND job_type = 'QUERY' AND statement_type != 'SCRIPT'
GROUP BY user_email
ORDER BY tib_billed DESC;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Script parent jobs are excluded so child statements are not counted twice.

2. **[SQL] Cost per day.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT DATE(creation_time) AS day,
       ROUND(SUM(total_bytes_billed) / POW(1024, 4) * 6.25, 2) AS est_cost_usd
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_PROJECT
WHERE creation_time &gt; TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND statement_type != 'SCRIPT'
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Slot-hours (for capacity pricing).**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT DATE(creation_time) AS day, ROUND(SUM(total_slot_ms) / 1000 / 3600, 2) AS slot_hours
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_PROJECT
WHERE creation_time &gt; TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND statement_type != 'SCRIPT'
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Multiply slot-hours by your edition's price per slot-hour to compare models.

4. **[CLI] Save a daily cost table with a scheduled query.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab20
bq mk --transfer_config --data_source=scheduled_query --target_dataset=lab20 \
  --display_name=daily_cost --schedule="every 24 hours" \
  --params='{"query":"SELECT DATE(creation_time) AS day, user_email, SUM(total_bytes_billed) AS bytes FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_PROJECT WHERE DATE(creation_time) = DATE_SUB(@run_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND statement_type != \"SCRIPT\" GROUP BY 1, 2","destination_table_name_template":"daily_cost","write_disposition":"WRITE_APPEND"}'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| On-demand cost | Bytes billed × price per TiB |
| Capacity cost | Slot-hours × price per slot-hour |
| Scripts | Exclude parent `SCRIPT` jobs |
| History | Daily cost table built by a schedule |
